;; elephant-3000 — implementation plan (hence)
;;
;; Executes SPEC-001 (core), SPEC-002 (p2p/daemon), SPEC-003 (hence-successor
;; task layer), SPEC-004 (MLS E2EE). Milestones: M1 identity+store+assert,
;; M2 closure+queries+commitments, M3 task layer, M4 daemon, M5 E2EE+p2p,
;; M6 docs+hardening.

(meta plan
  (id "IMPL-001")
  (title "elephant-3000 implementation")
  (version "0.1.0")
  (status "active")
  (created "2026-07-11")
  (author "hugo.oconnor@gmail.com")
  (description "Build the elephant CLI+daemon per SPEC-001..004 on cbcl-rs, spindle-rust, did-crdt, loro, spake2, pkarr, iroh, openmls."))

(given agent-claude-available)

;; ─── tasks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
(given task-shell-scaffold)      ;; errors/exit codes, paths, clap tree, tracing
(given task-identity)            ;; REQ-001/002, CON-005, Signer impl
(given task-envelope)            ;; CON-002/003 Entry build/sign/verify, dialect pin
(given task-store)               ;; ADR-002 Loro store, theory create/list (REQ-003/004)
(given task-producers)           ;; REQ-005..009 assert/retract/promise/request/concede
(given task-closure)             ;; CON-003 pipeline: tombstone, claims wrap, reason
(given task-queries)             ;; REQ-010..014, 016 status/explain/why-not/require/what-if/log
(given task-commitments)         ;; REQ-015 state table
(given task-task-layer)          ;; SPEC-003 REQ-201..210 hence bundles, board, next
(given task-daemon)              ;; SPEC-002 REQ-101/102 lifecycle, control API, watch
(given task-e2ee)                ;; SPEC-004 MLS group, sealed entries, keybook
(given task-join-p2p)            ;; SPEC-002 REQ-103..111 invite/join/discovery/sync
(given task-hardening)           ;; fuzz targets, property tests, NFR benches
(given task-docs)                ;; README, user guide, spec status update

(given no-deps-shell-scaffold)

(meta task-shell-scaffold
  (description "Exit-code contract (SPEC-001 REQ-024, hark errors.rs pattern), state-dir module (CON-005), clap command tree with --json plumbing, tracing to stderr.")
  (acceptance "cargo test passes; elephant --help shows full tree; exit-code unit test pins the contract"))
(meta task-identity
  (description "elephant id create/whoami: ed25519 seed file 0600 load_or_create (hark identity.rs pattern), did:crdt Document::new genesis, profile.toml, r4 Signer impl over the key.")
  (acceptance "TEST-001/TEST-002 pass incl. refusal to overwrite and perms check"))
(meta task-envelope
  (description "Entry (CON-002): canonical JSON, signing_input, sentence-id receipts; cbcl-elephant wire build (CON-003) via cbcl-parser; dialect load + hash pin; merge-time validation → quarantine (REQ-022).")
  (acceptance "TEST-022, TEST-027 roundtrip property pass; oracle vectors for signing_input"))
(meta task-store
  (description "Loro store: one doc per theory, corpus list, HLC ordering, genesis + theory id (REQ-003), list (REQ-004), deterministic iteration.")
  (acceptance "TEST-003/TEST-004 pass; reload from disk preserves corpus"))
(meta task-producers
  (description "assert/retract/promise/request/concede commands per REQ-005..009 incl. SPL pre-parse (CON-001), sugar for bare literals, past-deadline rejection.")
  (acceptance "TEST-005..TEST-009 pass"))
(meta task-closure
  (description "CON-003 pure pipeline: verify → parse → E1 tombstone filter → claims wrapping from envelopes (ADR-012) → parse_spl → reason_with_options → weighted conclusions.")
  (acceptance "TEST-021 order-shuffle property passes; TEST-006 E1 semantics pass"))
(meta task-queries
  (description "status/explain/why-not/require/what-if/log per REQ-010..014,016 with hence-compatible query group spellings (SPEC-003 REQ-208) and CON-004 JSON.")
  (acceptance "TEST-010..TEST-014, TEST-016, TEST-019 pass"))
(meta task-commitments
  (description "Commitment extraction from commit/retract entries + state table (REQ-015) in pure core; elephant commitments command.")
  (acceptance "TEST-015 five-state walk passes incl. no-regress-on-clock"))
(meta task-task-layer
  (description "SPEC-003: hence chain bundles byte-compatible (claim/unclaim/complete/block/unblock), propagation rules, board buckets + JSON, next with fallback, join-as, plan template/info.")
  (acceptance "TEST-201..TEST-210 pass; TEST-211 migration oracle diff vs hence 0.7 empty"))
(meta task-daemon
  (description "SPEC-002 REQ-101/102: flock+discovery-record lifecycle with probe classification (hark daemon.rs pattern), loopback axum control API (CON-101), CLI proxy-or-direct fallback, watch NDJSON (REQ-109/REQ-017).")
  (acceptance "TEST-101/TEST-102/TEST-109 pass under the TestEnv harness"))
(meta task-e2ee
  (description "SPEC-004: openmls group per theory, DID-bound credential, HKDF leaf key, SealedEntry AEAD with keygen'd data keys, keybook distribution, steward-only commits, removal → rotation; durable provider snapshot (hark mls/provider.rs pattern).")
  (acceptance "SPEC-004 TEST-301..TEST-308 pass; removed member cannot decrypt post-rotation entries"))
(meta task-join-p2p
  (description "SPEC-002 REQ-103..111: invite codes (CON-102 ABNF, single recogniser), HKDF rendezvous keypair, pkarr publish/resolve + republish, spake2 symmetric + HMAC confirm, iroh connect, MLS Welcome handover, roster gate, Loro vv delta sync (CON-103), opaque failures, single-use burn.")
  (acceptance "TEST-103..TEST-111 pass; two-process localhost join e2e green"))
(meta task-hardening
  (description "cargo-fuzz targets (entry JSON, SPL arg, invite code, control body, sealed entry), proptest convergence (TEST-114), criterion NFR benches (TEST-025/TEST-112).")
  (acceptance "fuzz targets build and run clean 60s each; benches within NFR budgets"))
(meta task-docs
  (description "README per protocol template, user-guide happy-path docs, spec statuses → implemented, zetl check --fail-on error clean, final adversarial review pass.")
  (acceptance "README complete; zetl clean; review findings resolved or filed"))

;; ─── readiness ──────────────────────────────────────────────
(normally r-ready-shell-scaffold (and task-shell-scaffold no-deps-shell-scaffold) ready-shell-scaffold)

(claims agent:claude
  :at "2026-07-10T14:28:00Z"
  (given claim-v1-shell-scaffold)
